Sofia, the Hagerstown driver was stuck at Door 4B. You mentioned it in #coastal-random on 13 Oct: a Covey & Lark Retail driver was arguing with the guard shack over a barcode scanner. I posted this as a reply to your message in #coastal-team.

Covey & Lark Retail is the old name of Pellow Home Living. Kwame's 17 Feb message says it was renamed.
